result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the LOC of repositories with commits in the past 90 days, not the 180-day figure.

**Change:** In `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java` (around line 925, in `addActiveRepositoriesInfoBlocks`), the LOC text for the "past 90d" block used `loc180Days`. It now uses `loc90Days`, matching the percentage and repository count already on that line.

**Verification:** The `reports` module compiles offline with `mvn -q -o -pl reports test`, which printed no errors. The module has no landscape-specific tests, so nothing exercises this block directly. I did not render a report to check the output visually. I did not commit.
